title: I made a free browser WW2 grand strategy game, starting with Kiev 1941. Would love feedback
author: prohealthypets
selftext:
Hey everyone 👋  
I've been building **Tides of Steel**, a WW2 strategy game inspired by HOI4 and Rising Nations, and it's finally out publicly. You can play it free in your browser.  
It started as a single scenario, the Kiev encirclement of 1941, but the plan is to cover battles from every theatre of the war and maybe eventual to control an entire nation. 

I currently have:  
A money economy where every unit costs you  
Raising troops in towns you control  
Grouping units into armies and running your own fronts  
Single player for now

**What's next:** more battle maps, a Steam release, and multiplayer coming back once it's there.  
It’s just me and Claude and honestly every suggestion gets read, so if something feels off, broken, or ahistorical, tell me 🫡   
Play here: tidesofsteel.org  
TikTok updates: @tides.of.steel  
Thanks for checking it out!
